notes.title: More Fixes & Balances
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Items no longer persist after leaving or restarting a stage.
[*] Footstep sounds now stop correctly when taking damage or dying.
[*] Bombers can no longer be pushed while exploding.
[*] Explosions no longer disappear when switching scenes.
[*] Effect and music volumes now save properly.
[/list]

[b]Balances:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed very low movement speed while shooting with some characters.
[*] Reduced bullet speed.
[*] Reduced Skip’s ultimate speed.
[/list]
